public_definitions: Goal: identify the emissions-reduction program with the largest contribution, then send that program to the accelerated program review queue.
Routing basis: Largest city emissions-reduction contribution program.
Option: Route Building retrofits to accelerated program review.
Option: Route Transit electrification to accelerated program review.
Option: Keep Industrial efficiency in routine program monitoring.
